{{Quote|In the first wave alone, the Sith succeeded in seizing control of several star systems in the Outer Rim, destroying the Republic's shipyards in the Sluis sector, and strangling the popular Rimma Trade Route.|A HoloNet dossier on the Sith Empire|<ref name="Empire" />}}
In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3681 BBY]], the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]] was '''blockaded''' by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] in an attempt to strangle the resources of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The action was one of the earliest conflicts of the [[Great Galactic War]], and occurred shortly after the Empire's [[Assault on the Tingel Arm region|return]] to the [[The galaxy/Legends|known galaxy]]. As part of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor's]] plan to secure the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], the Rimma [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] was locked down, which resulted in further Republic losses and interior [[Politics/Legends|political]] [[Senate emergency defense session|turmoil]]. While Republic forces in the Outer Rim suffered from a lack of supplies and reinforcements&mdash;particularly those in the [[Minos Cluster Campaign|embattled]] [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]]&mdash;military leaders organized efforts to retake the Rimma [[Hyperspace route/Legends|Trade Route]]. After the [[Republic Army]]'s first unsuccessful [[First battle of the Seswenna sector|counterattack]], the blockade was ended in [[3680 BBY]], when a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] regrouped in the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]] and launched a [[Second battle of the Seswenna sector|second assault]]. The attack succeeded in breaking the Empire's hold on the route, thereby allowing the Republic to ship war materiel and reinforcements to Outer Rim battlefronts.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|The onslaught of the Sith Empire was an event unlike any other in the history of the Republic. The Sith materialized from nowhere and launched an offensive of colossal proportions.|Jedi Master Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Timeline 6" />}}
[[File:Korriban_station_under_attack.png|thumb|right|250px|The Empire's victory at Korriban was the direct result of the Republic's unpreparedness for such an assault.]]
After more than a [[Time/Legends|millennium]] of [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exile]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], the [[Sith Empire/Legends|ancient Sith Empire]] returned to [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] notoriety in [[3681 BBY]]<ref name="Timeline6date" /> in a [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|new and robust form]] intent on the destruction of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in a conflict that became known as the [[Great Galactic War]]. The [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] leader, known only as the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]], led his people in a campaign to secure the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] in a swift and unforgiving offensive. After [[Assault on the Tingel Arm region|highly]] [[Assault on the Aparo sector|successful]] [[Tingel Arm campaign|efforts]] in the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]] region and the [[Battle of Korriban|recapture]] of the Sith's ancestral [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], the Empire pressed its advantage and widened its offensive.<ref name="Timeline 6" /> Imperial forces [[Minos Cluster Campaign|invaded]] the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] and enacted a [[Battle of Sluis Van (Great Galactic War)|mass slaughter]] on the Republic [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Sluis Van/Legends|Sluis Van]]. Meanwhile, the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Armada]] set its sights on the highly valuable [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]]<ref name="JoMGD" /> that connected the planet [[Abregado-rae/Legends|Abregado-rae]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] to the distant Outer Rim.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==The blockade==
{{SeeAlso|First battle of the Seswenna sector|Second battle of the Seswenna sector}}
{{Quote|There is yet hope in the Seswenna sector, as we understand that the Republic fleet regrouped and broke up the blockade of the Rimma Trade Route, meaning more resources to support the fighting there and for those of us battling here in the Minos Cluster.|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Timeline 6" />}}
In the first [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the war, the Sith's [[Navy/Legends|navy]] moved onto the Rimma [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]],<ref name="Timeline 6" /> successfully [[Blockade/Legends|blockading]] the path by stationing the bulk of its [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] in the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]],<ref name="JoMGD" /> near the edge of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> With the vital and extensive [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|lane]] under their control, the Imperials strangled Republic supply lines in a highly effective operation<ref name="Empire" /> that strained the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] defenders in the Minos [[Star cluster/Legends|Cluster]] and the forces of the Republic across the Outer Rim.<ref name="JoMGD" /> The repercussions that weighed heavily on the Republic's [[Republic Military/Legends|defense force]] were also felt on the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where the blockade contributed to a panic in the upper echelons of galactic [[Politics/Legends|politics]].<ref name="Timeline 6" /> The Republic Military eventually staged a [[First battle of the Seswenna sector|counterattack]] in the Seswenna [[Sector/Legends|sector]] but suffered a devastating loss that saw the capture of hundreds of [[Republic soldier]]s. Although news of the failed assault was greatly demoralizing for other Republic forces in the Outer Rim that relied on supplies from the Rimma Trade Route, the fleets of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] were able to regroup<ref name="JoMGD" /> by [[3680 BBY]]<ref name="JoMGDdating" /> and launch yet [[Second battle of the Seswenna sector|another attack]] in the Seswenna region. That effort proved effective, and the Sith blockade of the trade route was broken, freeing up transport for Republic supplies to the Outer Rim Territories.<ref name="JoMGD" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Republic leaders and members of the Jedi Council arranged an emergency meeting in the Senate to prioritize the galaxy's defense, but the session quickly became mired in politics.|Gnost-Dural|<ref name="Timeline 6" />}}
[[File:Rimma_Trade_Route.jpg|thumb|left|350px|The Rimma Trade Route]]
Although it was ultimately broken by the naval forces of the Republic, the year-long<ref name="JoMGD" /> blockade of the Rimma Trade Route was a highly successful endeavor, particularly in conjunction with the Imperial victory in the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]]. Additionally, it allowed for the Sith to gain an early advantage over the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] in the Empire's attempt to acquire the resource-rich Minos Cluster. The series of losses for the Republic forced government leaders and the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] to organize an [[Senate emergency defense session|emergency defense summit]] in an attempt to organize and prioritize the galaxy's military resources. The meeting, held by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], ended in political gridlock, as [[Senator/Legends|senators]] and other [[Congressman|representatives]] refused to take part in deliberations if they felt that their constituent worlds were overlooked. While the political crisis continued in the highest echelons of the Republic government, the Empire moved onward to sweep the Outer Rim Territories in their widely successful war.<ref name="Timeline 6" />

In [[3671 BBY]], ten years after their initial seizure of the Rimma Trade Route, the Empire returned to the Seswenna sector and [[Third battle of the Seswenna sector|seized]] the region, sealing their dominion over much of the Outer Rim.<ref name="Timeline 6" /> The blockade of major hyperspace lanes became the most effective tactic in the war,<ref name="TEA" /> particularly when the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior clans entered the conflict on behalf of the Empire. In [[3661 BBY]], the Mandalorians [[Blockade of the Hydian Way|seized]] the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]]; with the Mandalorian's blockade of the Hydian<ref name="Timeline 3">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 3: The Return of the Mandalorians|int=Timeline 3: The Return of the Mandalorians}}</ref> and the Sith's control of the Rimma Trade Route in the Seswenna sector,<ref name="Timeline 6" /> the Empire had control of two of the galaxy's most vital supply lines.<ref name="Timeline 3" /> The [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Gnost-Dural]] kept a [[The Journal of Master Gnost-Dural|journal]] during the Great Galactic War that included references to the Rimma blockade, as well as his own feelings of relief after it was originally broken in 3,680 BBY; as a Republic defender in the Minos Cluster, Gnost-Dural and his comrades relied upon reinforcements and supplies that were shipped along the hyperroute.<ref name="JoMGD" /> After the conclusion of the war with the signing of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] in [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="Deceived">''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]''</ref> Gnost-Dural's journal,<ref name="JoMGD" /> as well as a scholarly [[Galactic Timeline (in-universe)|holodocumentary]] produced by the Kel Dor on the early days of the war and the Rimma Trade Route blockade, were submitted to the [[Jedi Archives (Tython)|Jedi Archives]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] for record-keeping purposes.<ref name="Timeline 6" />

==Behind the scenes==
The blockade of the Rimma Trade Route was created as part of the back-story for the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The event was first mentioned on the Sith Empire's [[in-universe]] [[The Holonet|Holonet]] page, published on ''The Old Republic'' [http://www.swtor.com website].<ref name="Empire" />
